If you would like to post an announcement about a call for papers, a workshop, a conference meeting, a call for grants, awards or studentships, or a faculty position related to judgement and/or decision-making, or have comments/suggestions about our website, please contact the EADM <a href="mailto:michael@eadm.eu">webmaster</a>.

Contact the EADM Treasurer: <a href="mailto:treasurer@eadm.eu">treasurer@eadm.eu</a>,  for any query related to your membership.

Please see our <a href = 'https://eadm.eu/mailinglist/'>this page</a> for instructions on how to subscribe to the EADM mailing list.
